description: Peer-to-peer consensus traffic: rates of proposals and validations received from peers and their split between trusted and untrusted sources.

panels.title: Peer Proposal Receive Rate
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of consensus proposals arriving from connected network peers.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Reflects how many validators' proposals reach this node each round.
**Healthy range:** Workload-dependent; scales with peer count and network activity.
**Watch for:** A sudden drop means loss of proposal flow; a sharp sustained spike from a single peer can indicate flooding.
**Source:** src/xrpld/overlay/detail/PeerImp.cpp:PeerImp::onMessage(TMProposeSet)

panels.title: Peer Validation Receive Rate
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of ledger validations arriving from connected network peers.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Reflects the volume of validation traffic reaching this node.
**Healthy range:** Workload-dependent; scales with the number of validators and peers.
**Watch for:** A drop starves the validation quorum; an abnormal spike from one peer can indicate abuse.
**Source:** src/xrpld/overlay/detail/PeerImp.cpp:PeerImp::onMessage(TMValidation)

panels.title: Proposals Trusted vs Untrusted
panels.description:
**What:** Share of received proposals from trusted validators (in this node's UNL) versus untrusted sources.
**How it's computed:** Total counts split by trust status over a 5-minute window, shown as proportions.
**Reading it:** A well-connected node with a good UNL sees a healthy trusted share.
**Healthy range:** A substantial trusted proportion; exact mix is workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** A collapse of the trusted share means poor connectivity to UNL validators; a flood of untrusted proposals can indicate abuse.
**Source:** src/xrpld/overlay/detail/PeerImp.cpp:PeerImp::onMessage(TMProposeSet)

targets.expr: sum by (proposal_trusted, service_instance_id) (increase(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", proposal_trusted=~"$proposal_trusted", span_name="peer.proposal.receive"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Validations Trusted vs Untrusted
panels.description:
**What:** Share of received validations from trusted validators (in this node's UNL) versus untrusted sources.
**How it's computed:** Total counts split by trust status over a 5-minute window, shown as proportions.
**Reading it:** Confirms the node is hearing from its expected trusted validator set.
**Healthy range:** A substantial trusted proportion; exact mix is workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** A shrinking trusted share risks the validation quorum; a surge of untrusted validations can indicate abuse.
**Source:** src/xrpld/overlay/detail/PeerImp.cpp:PeerImp::onMessage(TMValidation)
